info.name: AirAPI - SS-6309 CMS route inversion update
info.description: Ticket-scoped dev Search regression for fare-level routingInversion. Credentials are environment variables.

exec: pm.test('[' + caseId + '] Search succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
let body; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (error) { pm.test('[' + caseId + '] Search response is JSON', function () { throw error; }); return; }
pm.test('[' + caseId + '] results are returned', function () { pm.expect(body.results).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

const expected = pm.variables.get('expected_inversion') === 'true'; const targetDeparture = pm.variables.get('target_departure'); const targetArrival = pm.variables.get('target_arrival'); const matchingFares = []; (body.results || []).forEach(function (result) { const calculation = result.keys && result.keys.commission_info && result.keys.commission_info.fareCalculation; if (!calculation) return; Object.keys(calculation).forEach(function (paxType) { (calculation[paxType] || []).forEach(function (fare) { if (fare.departure === targetDeparture && fare.arrival === targetArrival) matchingFares.push(fare); }); }); });
pm.test('[' + caseId + '] target fare is returned', function () { pm.expect(matchingFares).to.not.be.empty; });

matchingFares.forEach(function (fare, index) { pm.test('[' + caseId + '] target fare ' + index + ' exposes routingInversion', function () { pm.expect(fare).to.have.property('routingInversion'); pm.expect(fare.routingInversion).to.be.a('boolean'); }); if (typeof fare.routingInversion === 'boolean') pm.test('[' + caseId + '] target fare ' + index + ' has expected routing inversion', function () { pm.expect(fare.routingInversion).to.equal(expected); }); });
